utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Lift it? Am I supposed to lift it?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Lift it first. Get your fabric under there. Make sure it's lined up with the tape.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Now put the needle down. You know, turn the needle.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Wait, let me just check the framing of the camera. I think the lighting is hitting the thread wrong. Do you think I should move the lamp?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: The needle, honey. Turn the wheel to put the needle down into the fabric first. Don't worry about the lamp.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Right, the lamp... wait, did you say move the fabric? I'm trying to see if the colors pop on the screen.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I'm stopping right here. I'm not saying it a third time while you're staring at that screen. We are stalled until you look at the presser foot and do what I said with the needle. The sewing machine doesn't care about your lighting.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Mm-hmm. No, towards you. Keep turning it. Keep turning. There you go. Now you can take your pin out.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: That's what you were wanting to do.
